method: A meaningless copy-and-perturb procedure draws a training vocabulary token with probability 0.62; otherwise it chooses uniformly among the preceding ten generated tokens and applies a randomly chosen insertion, deletion, or substitution using glyph frequencies from public practice-training paragraph text. Seed 10117. No page, section, or paragraph position is used. The whole transcription is consulted only to reject a candidate that would complete a forbidden four-word manuscript sequence; 24,000 generated tokens are then cut to evaluation layout. The copying mechanism was selected to probe the near-copy fact, so a success should be interpreted as a targeted, potentially weak refutation rather than independent evidence for a historical production method.
